name: Manifold Dual Contouring - 2D Point Search
definition: A procedure to find auxiliary points (2D points) on grid faces to better approximate local surface normals than the gradient of the implicit function used in MDC, by capturing actual local geometry within each grid face.
summary: The 2D Point Search computes auxiliary points on grid faces to approximate local surface normals more accurately than gradients, using a line-binary search strategy to refine normals.
